hook.en: Now he wants to tell stories.

objective: Meta episode: The Traveler turns toward storytelling itself — YouTube, characters, his own journey as content. A new portal opens that looks disconnected from everything before it, but by now both The Traveler and the audience recognize the pattern: it will probably connect to the map too.

metadata.call_to_action: Otra curiosidad. Probablemente también se conecta.

captions.es: El mapa incluso se dibuja a sí mismo contándose.
captions.en: The map even draws itself by telling itself.

metadata.thumbnail_concept: A new, still-dim portal opening beside all the others on Moon's map, labeled only with a question mark, The Traveler and NØVA looking at it together

notes: Act XI of the Origin Saga — see ../../canon/ORIGIN-SAGA.md. This episode is meta: it is, itself, part of what it depicts (the Opsly Creator Studio content system that produced this very series).
Theme: recursion — the pattern of 'another world that looks disconnected but probably connects' repeats one more time, this time as the show itself.
Emotional conflict: minimal / reflective beat rather than a struggle — a brief pause before the season's mystery payoff (Episodes 12-13).
Visual motif: the portal opens dim/unlabeled, deliberately unresolved — mirrors the season's 'map still being drawn' ending.

Real event / fictionalization boundary: see ../../canon/TIMELINE.md row 11. This episode IS the real event (Opsly Creator Studio / this content pipeline) — keep the fictionalization light, almost a wink to the audience.
Placed just before The Message/The Map (12-13) so the season's final act returns fully to the core mystery thread.
